problems.reason: Sentences 14–19 present mutually inconsistent views on the family placement of Goyocephale, alternating between Homalocephalidae, Pachycephalosauridae, paraphyly, and monophyly.
Both sentences state that Homalocephalidae is paraphyletic and its genera are early branches of Pachycephalosauridae.
Both sentences claim a single Homalocephalidae family with Goyocephale, Homalocephale, and Wannanosaurus as the most derived members.
